_comment: Which wireframe covers which declared visualiser, read by check:wireframes (scripts/check-wireframes.ts), which reads this file as the wireframes of this layer's site directory (`docs/`) and names each `cat-harness-tools/<topic>`. This layer declares no visualiser of its own; it holds the WRITERS other layers' visualisers name in `renderedBy`, so a wireframe here covers a writer's page by `renderedBy:<tool>`: every declared visualiser drawn by that Tool inherits it (owner, 2026-11-17, option b: one shared ArchiMate wireframe for dth-hrh, dpi-h-ra, dth-phc, dth-sfp and every later layer that declares an `archimate-pages` visualiser). A layer that wants its own drawing of such a page still names it by route key in its own index, and that wins.
